title: Swift Algorithms: chunked(on:)
hints: Walk the sequence remembering the previous element's key.
Same key as last time → append to the last chunk; different key → start a new chunk.
`if let lastKey, lastKey == k { chunks[chunks.count - 1].append(element) } else { chunks.append([element]) }`.
jsBridge: `chunked(on:)` groups **consecutive** elements with the same key, unlike `Dictionary(grouping:)`, which groups all of them. lodash has no direct equivalent. It comes from Apple's swift-algorithms package, Swift's "lodash".
